nb2_lite.texto: A photograph of the same people shown in the reference images. The young Spanish bride in a modest white dress and the mid-20s Spanish groom in a dark suit, with family guests in dark wool clothing. The newlyweds step out of a church door onto the street as relatives gather. Spanish people with olive to fair Mediterranean skin, dark brown to black hair and brown eyes. Stone church entrance on a Madrid street, September 1962, a SEAT 600 parked at the kerb. Soft late-summer afternoon daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, deep depth of field, 35mm lens. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 1962, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio. No readable text, no signage, no labels.
